summary: Kairos Pharma, Ltd. filed a Form 8-K on May 18, 2026, to announce the issuance of a new investor presentation for its CEO's presentation at the 2026 LD Micro Invitational XVI. The filing contains no transaction or special situation; it merely furnishes a general business update on clinical programs and partnering activities as a routine investor relations disclosure. The information is furnished and not deemed filed under the Exchange Act.
